generation.scope: Every finite edge over the degree-20 input, including all exceptional choices, is a binary catalecticant edge of a Hankel structure on the same five-by-five linear quintic symmetroid. The quartic involution of its kernel surface forces the whole Veronese fourfold into the Grassmannian by Pfaffian inversion.

open_mathematics: Compare both actual adjacent Hankel structures: distinct structures induce the forbidden standard trisecant window and equal structures force a cubic-quintic fold.
